title: Proposed Omni commercial contract C6-1 — three original-scope deltas
description: Additive C6-1 freezes the reviewed public numeric price projection, source-eligible hosted Asaas Pix/card and contextual provider/method/operation choices.42 commands/41 recoverables/3 public GETs remain; C6 associations, journeys, operational work, guards and observed method semantics preserved. No source publication or operational approval.

x-trusted-context.construction: Resolved and verified by trusted middleware, revalidated per command and effect; never deserialized request assertions.

x-invariants: No subject body parsing or REAL forms before qualified lifecycle/identity/representation/tenant/purpose/source gates.
Intake values go only to a qualified source/vault port after descriptor validation; never financial journal, logs, analytics or browser persistence.
All caller receipt refs are lookup selectors, never authority; resolve authentic current evidence server-side.
Result kind must equal the command result_kind. Unknown keys rejected recursively.
contract state issued requires matching nonnull issued_receipt; every other state has null issued_receipt.
contract.issue succeeds only with state issued and verified source receipt; pending source effects return uncertain.
Catalog rows must contain at least one product; imports reject whole batch on invalid/duplicate product.
Catalog author differs from reviewer and publisher; approval binds exact digest/version.
Method/provider combinations constrained by x-provider-methods; provider choice must also be source-authorized.
Contract acceptance/issuance/enrollment/coverage remain independent.
Receivable ensure requires current issued receipt and proceed authority, payer and source billing obligation.
Stable business dedupe persists across command_ref changes and provider switches.
Attempt provider/account/invoice/value/currency immutable; uncertain holds cross-provider claim until authoritative reconciliation.
No operator, provider, catalog, receipt or tenant reference is accepted merely because it conforms to Ref syntax.
Every monthly charge consumes a new Tasy-issued invoice; mandate is optional and never calendar authority.
Hosted action URL must match configured official provider HTTPS origin and original merchant account; no arbitrary redirects or PAN/CVV.
BRL minor units only in v1; other currencies require a versioned contract change.
Payment paid/settled/Tasy acknowledged are independent authenticated receipts.
InfinitePay unauthenticated webhook is hint only; authenticated provider lookup establishes financial facts.
Runtime default denies absent approved binding/secret store/current authority; synthetic adapter injection never creates real admission.

C1 operation.get accepts original target_command_ref only; tenant, owner and authority are resolved/revalidated server-side before lookup or disclosure; absent and foreign targets share a non-leaking refusal.

C1 operation.get may query source using the original effect identity; it never redispatches an uncertain write. The original result is a bounded nonrecursive envelope with no operation_status nested kind, sanitized before storage/replay.
C1 post-dispatch uncertainty returns a non-null opaque operation_ref. A lost response is recoverable using the original caller command_ref under current authority.

C1 acceptance.record composes existing proposed OP03 semantics with an admitted source: exact quote revision, terms digest, party/delegate, current source authority; accepted only with authenticated immutable source receipt. No locally minted acceptance and no assertion by checkbox.
C1 original_result persists no personal intake, proof, credential or hosted checkout URL. A recovered reference is not authority; current owner/resource/source checks precede any follow-up command.

C2 HostedAction.expires_at null explicitly means provider did not publish absolute URL validity. Never infer midnight/TTL from boleto dueDate, and never assume an unknown-expiry URL remains usable. Delivery requires fresh qualified source/account/current resource authority; no durable URL or replay. Boleto due date is a distinct Tasy/provider fact.

C3 operator proposals contain source-authorized choice references, not merchant account IDs, secrets, source proof or activation booleans. Review must be by a different actor on the exact revision/digest; activation independently resolves current source ownership and all three methods.

C3 operator.register may activate or update a source-qualified reviewed proposal without changing immutable old payment attempt/provider/account bindings. Operator choices and proposals are private administrative data, not anonymous catalogue projections.

C3 mandate.get queries current PSP/source status; only authenticated matching setup/opt-in/payer/account evidence can activate. Revoke is not confirmed until source acknowledgement. A new Tasy obligation with an active authorized mandate routes off-session without adding a PSP invoice calendar.
C3 contract.get refreshes authorized current source obligations; financial_action.get queries the competent current source(s) and never infers completion from request transport success.

C3 notification ingress preflights current source/lifecycle/tenant and authenticates bounded raw transport before interpreting fields; unknown source bindings refuse before reading body. Untrusted hints cannot update ledger without authenticated original-instrument lookup and matching inbox acknowledgement.

C3 intake custody is separate qualified encrypted staging, governed by source-defined fields/purpose/lifecycle. Financial journal and command hashes contain only opaque staged references/metadata, never raw personal values or public low-entropy value digests.
C4 display_name for proposals/drafts is bounded160 matching existing operator activation and result; never truncate or silently change reviewed content.

C4 operator.activate receives only proposal_ref, never binding proof. Server loads exact reviewed revision, checks different actors/current source ownership/all three methods, resolves qualified binding references internally and activates atomically. Existing low-level operator.register payload is preserved verbatim, including display_name/legal_entity_ref/tasy_binding_ref/psp_binding_refs; it is not a UI form for callers to claim qualification.
C5 offer.terms is the sole new command: 34 commands and 33 nonrecursive recoverable command names. Existing routes and wire version remain candidate-only.

C5 fresh terms_presentation matches exact quote/source_revision/terms_digest and authentic current actor/representation/source; hosted_document URLs use independently qualified operator/issuer origins, never the PSP allowlist by inference.
C5 pending source presentation never enables acceptance. presented requires a source-authenticated exact-document handoff receipt, not a claim that a human read or understood it.

C5 acceptance.record request and source acceptance receipt both require matching terms_review_ref; acceptance source independently enforces current presented proof before accepted. No browser checkbox or redirect creates that proof.

C5 fresh offer.terms requires a current qualified hosted_document; known expired URLs refuse, unknown absolute expiry requires explicit source qualification and fresh delivery evidence. Never manufacture validity or expiry.

C5 terms document URLs and bytes never enter durable journal/outbox/cache/replay/recovery. Recovered offer.terms uses the same result kind with hosted_document null; it does not authorize accept. Issue a new fresh offer.terms to revalidate current source.
C5 no source presentation means unavailable and no accept action. Existing admission, source, identity, lifecycle, finance, clinical and human gates remain unchanged.
C6 preserves35requirements;42privatecommands/41recoverables plus3separatepublicGET boundaries. Public browsing has no account requirement and no manufactured customer authority.

C6 catalog.publish must atomically install the exact qualified source public projection and active pointer; draft never replaces published projection, withdrawal invalidates pointer without erasing history. Public reader uses this stored governed projection with fresh source/policy checks, not an unrelated opaque future port.

C6 public source DTO uses the existing camelCase catalog-read and translateCatalogRead projection; no raw private CatalogRow, arbitrary domain inference, PSP data or subject preferences are accepted/disclosed.

C6 current responsible queue/group policy is required before preparing effects. Durable work responsibility is atomic with effect/outbox/event state; human owner and worker execution lease remain distinct.

C6 runner is actually composed and invoked by AMH lifecycle/factory, calls scoped pending discovery and original-source query before effects; an uncalled worker/port does not complete internal implementation.

C6 work claim/assignment/handoff requires current staff owner/group/resource authority. Source-advertised actions preserve original provider/account/invoice binding; received handoff is not executed action; browser cannot complete or authorize money.

C6 requested method immutable; observed_method and observed_method_receipt_ref are a nullable authenticated pair. Paid with unknown actual method cannot produce Tasy acknowledgement and retains duplicate-charge protection plus responsible exception work.
C6 preserve acknowledged Tasy facts across unchanged PSP observations; authenticated provider lookup refs persist atomically for later original-operation reconciliation; unsigned hints never rebind.
C6 receivable.get must acquire qualified current source data. Late hosted-link validation follows all authority IO. These internal repairs require no additional private commands.

C6 public catalog publication never authorizes REAL preferences, guest client state or quote input. Independent current anonymous/minimal-administrative identity-category, purpose/lifecycle and actual qualified intake transport are required before controls and again before body; absent provider leaves read-only content available and inputs disabled.

C6 tasy_ack_state pending/unknown cannot carry an acknowledged receipt; repair must preserve historical source facts and requalify any contradictory legacy projection, never delete an authentic acknowledgement merely to satisfy the new shape.

C6 CatalogRow explicitly adds structured source-validated plan/network/establishment/unit/service association tuples; real form/CSV and published source v2/public v3 projections must compose them. Generic attributes are not association identity.

C6 journey.save/get and support.handoff compose actual durable source-bound account/representation discovery, exact saved quote context, tracking/documents/pending/responsibility and contextual support after fresh admission. Browser/manual-by-ref state alone is not reload recovery.
C6 support vocabulary is source-qualified at runtime; historical empty enums remain untouched. Clinical topics route only to a qualified external channel; no portal clinical text or invented receipt.

C6 journey/support hosted URLs are ephemeral and stripped in durable/recovered views. Every new action requires fresh source/currentness checks; an old displayed document, support receipt or saved quote is not current authority.
C6-1 adds no command and preserves42/41,3publicGET,35parents and allprior122subchecks. Only qualified public numbers, eligible Asaas methods and source-backed provider/operation choices change.

C6-1 public source v3/presentation v4 price is explicit unknown or actual publicly qualified numeric facts with kind/unit/period/applicability/currentness. No local total/minimum/from-price/personal eligibility or publication-to-privacy grant.

C6-1 Asaas possible hosted methods include boleto/pix/card, but account eligibility and contractual operation proof control actual choice. Requested billingType is not actual captured method; debit is not relabeled credit.

C6-1 transactional provider choices come from the exact current resource-scoped PaymentCapabilitySet; choice_ref is a selector, not a grant. Generic method/command availability cannot expose unsupported recurrence.
C6-1 optional recurrence remains Stripe-only under current opt-in/new Tasy invoices. InfinitePay/Asaas one-time card capability never implies mandate/off-session support.

C6-1 capability projections are sanitized to unavailable before durable/recovered storage; source facts and old bindings/acknowledgements remain intact. Stable accounting intent is independent of rotating PSP receipts even while uncertain.

PublicCatalogSourceWire.title: Source-qualified public catalog wire using existing catalog-read field vocabulary

PublicCatalogAssociationSourceWire.title: Source-qualified public catalog wire using existing catalog-read field vocabulary

PublicCatalogNumericSourceWire.title: Source-qualified public catalog wire using existing catalog-read field vocabulary

x-successor.subcheck_mapping: The two provider checks remain under existing COM-014/018/023; ROOT/original requirements reviewer maps them without dropping or renumbering prior122. Public price is explicit COM-005.SC-01/COM-007.SC-02.
x-successor.compatibility: No command added/removed. New required choice_ref on payment.create/mandate.create; mandate.create provider Stripe only. Existing data gains contextual payment_capabilities. Public source v3/presentation v4 adds qualified numeric price branch; prior fields/associations retained. Existing C6 requested/observed method fields and all other invariants preserved.

x-trusted-server-transport.credential: Server-resolved M2M credential only; never browser Authorization/cookie forwarding
x-trusted-server-transport.connection_header: X-Commercial-Connection opaque routing reference only; receiver authenticates caller then independently resolves current connection/actor/tenant/representation/purpose/source/lifecycle before body intake

x-terms-presentation.owner: Designated qualified operator/issuer terms source via AMH adapter; Maezo composes acceptance authority; Sales presents the qualified handoff.
x-terms-presentation.transport: Existing three proposed commercial POST routes; no external Tasy or document endpoint invented.
x-terms-presentation.source_port: TermsPresentationPort.present_terms(quote_ref, source_revision, terms_digest, trusted_context) resolves or prepares the source-owned handoff and queries authenticated current presentation evidence; no browser proof is trusted.
x-terms-presentation.acceptance_port: Existing qualified acceptance source must resolve terms_review_ref and independently enforce current presentation evidence before accepted; Maezo/AMH preflight is additional, never a replacement.
fresh_semantic_checks: Exact request/result quote_ref, source_revision and terms_digest equality; current unexpired quote and published terms/catalogue.
Resolve terms_review_ref against authenticated source; current tenant, actor, represented party, purpose, issuer/source binding and quote/version/digest must match.

pending requires null presentation_receipt_ref; presented requires authenticated source handoff receipt proving delivery of the exact terms to the currently authorized actor. Neither state attests reading or comprehension.

hosted_document is required only in fresh offer.terms success. Parse HTTPS URL, require exact independently source-qualified operator/issuer document origin, no userinfo, no fragment, no arbitrary redirect. Each redirect destination and any resumed source session must remain within the qualified issuer policy.
If source publishes expires_at, it must be strictly in the future against trusted current time and is rechecked immediately before delivery/use; malformed, expired or unqualified values refuse.

Null expiry means source explicitly has no absolute URL expiry; fresh authenticated validity/delivery evidence is still mandatory. Never derive expiry from quote expiry, invoice due date, a local TTL or current time.

Accept is enabled only on a fresh presented readback with nonnull source receipt, exact current quote/revision/digest and qualified current delivery validity. Source repeats these checks at actual acceptance time.
acceptance_semantic_checks: Required terms_review_ref appears in request and source acceptance receipt; exact equality must be checked along with quote/source_revision/party_linkage/terms_digest and decision mapping.

Source must independently validate review actor/representation/tenant/issuer/purpose/currentness and authenticated handoff receipt immediately before accepting, atomically with or under the source revision guard for acceptance.
A terms_review_ref is a selector, never a bearer grant. A forged string, browser click, checkbox, redirect completion, client timestamp or previously returned presented status never creates proof.
A declined decision may use a current bound pending review reference without claiming presentation; accepted always requires presented/current source proof.
Quote, terms, actor, represented party, source binding or authority revision change invalidates outstanding review evidence; acquire current source presentation before accepting.
x-terms-presentation.persistence: Persist only opaque terms_review_ref/presentation_receipt_ref and qualified source receipt lineage under existing custody policy; no hosted_document URL, document bytes, signed query tokens or raw source proof in financial journal, outbox, recovery, logs, analytics or browser persistence.
x-terms-presentation.replay: Strip hosted_document to null before journal append and every recovery projection. Recovered offer.terms success uses RecoveredTermsPresentationResultData only inside operation.get. Direct replay of a completed offer.terms command_ref returns unavailable/terms_presentation_unavailable with original operation_ref, never a sanitized object as fresh success and never the old URL. operation.get does not redispatch or produce a URL. A new offer.terms command_ref requalifies source and delivers a fresh current URL.
x-terms-presentation.scope: No document HTML/PDF copy, truncation threshold or local text fabrication; source hosts full exact terms. Document content does not enter this portal command protocol.

existing_source_schema.changes: Local ref rebasing and decimal-pattern encoding aligned to existing TypeScript MONEY_PATTERN; no field names or domain meanings changed.

x-public-catalog.existing_translator: src/server/adapters/catalog.ts:translateCatalogRead extended nominally source sales-catalog-read.proposed.v3 → presentation sales-catalog-presentation.proposed.v4; preserve old branches for their own contracts.
x-public-catalog.public_identity: Authenticated server machine identity with current source/publication/lifecycle/audience/operator-scope grant. No synthetic customer, anonymous customer principal, copied cookie, browser tenant or grant in request.
x-public-catalog.write_composition: catalog.publish resolves full qualified public source DTO for exact approved catalog_ref/version/digest/product refs/network refs. Recheck current source publication and field semantics; atomically commit catalog publication, immutable public projection, public active pointer, event and command result. Failure leaves prior active version unchanged and does not make the candidate sellable.
x-public-catalog.revision_semantics: A new draft/review never changes active publication. A new approved publish atomically replaces pointer with the exact qualified projection. Withdraw atomically invalidates matching active pointer and affected current offers while retaining immutable historical quote/receipt lineage; it does not erase issued contracts.
x-public-catalog.read_composition: AMH reads actual active projection and requalifies current public source policy, audience, lifecycle, publication/withdrawal/expiry, price and network source revisions. Maezo validates admitted source projection and returns the same source wire to Sales. Sales awaits shared public DAL, validates then invokes translateCatalogRead and returns only existing presentation DTO to pages/API.
x-public-catalog.no_inference: Private CatalogRow.attributes are never interpreted as modality, eligibility, coverage, waiting periods, ANS registry, network, prices or public authority. Full fields must originate in explicit source-qualified mapping; unknown remains unknown, no zeros/defaults/promises.
x-public-catalog.failure: Absent/unqualified/stale/withdrawn source or projection yields HTTP503 categorical PublicCatalogUnavailable at the public API and current CatalogRead unavailable presentation in pages. Never echo source authority or transport errors.
x-public-catalog.headers: No-store. Reject query/body and caller authority overrides before decoding private input. Browser cookies are not parsed for identity, persisted or forwarded; machine transport authentication exists only between servers.
x-public-catalog.bounds: At most100 published products in this candidate public response, enforced before publication/delivery without truncation; larger catalog requires explicitly versioned pagination. Existing product/criteria vocabulary preserved.

independent_journey_admission.port: Sales PublicJourneyAdmissionPort.resolve_current(journey_kind, trusted_server_context), independent of public catalog publication; unavailable by default.
independent_journey_admission.identity_category: Only a source-published and currently qualified anonymous/minimal-administrative identity category and purpose/lifecycle policy can authorize guest preferences. No fabricated human principal, account, env grant or publication boolean.
independent_journey_admission.before_controls: Resolve separately before rendering/enabling any REAL needs/filter/compare/preference/estimate controls, registering handlers or allocating subject client state. A usable catalog alone enables read-only content, not intake.
independent_journey_admission.before_body: Revalidate current approved descriptor, identity category, lifecycle/purpose/source and actual intake transport before decoding any submitted preferences. No guest intake endpoint is introduced by C6; absent corresponding qualified path means no input controls.
independent_journey_admission.existing_composition: Current public pages already pass read and access separately; preserve this separation when replacing literal unavailable DAL. Audit PublicPages/CatalogState and every introduced client component so source availability never substitutes for access.
independent_journey_admission.estimate: S06 may display only published Tasy facts or a qualified source estimate. No browser price/eligibility computation. Formal proposal follows deliberate proceed and qualified S07 identity/representation.
independent_journey_admission.dto: No privacy grant or guest permission is added to the public catalog response.

x-public-catalog.association_extension: C6 publishing requires the source v2/public v3 association extension: preserve all existing fields, add networkAssociations. Source private tuple refs stay server-side; browser receives only source-approved publicAssociationRef/labels/currentness. Unknown labels stay unknown; no credentialing, coverage or eligibility is inferred.
x-public-catalog.numeric_price_extension: price: unknown, or known with exact source-published numeric BRL money, amount kind/unit, billing period, applicability and currentness. Carry through actual publication transaction/storage/threeGETs/translator/DAL/results/detail/compare/S06. No minimum/from-price/total calculation, personal intake, or catalog-to-privacy grant.

x-workflow.audience: Authenticated qualified staff only; vendors/customers have no work commands. Current service worker identity is separately qualified, never a fake staff actor.
x-workflow.responsibility_before_effect: Resolve a current source-qualified responsible_queue_ref/group directory and permitted owner policy before preparing any external effect. Missing owner/group source refuses before effect preparation. Persist responsibility with effect intent, outbox, event and original command result in one atomic transaction.
x-workflow.work_item: Tenant-scoped durable work is maintained atomically with pending/uncertain/orphaned/source_action_required/accounting outcomes. owner_ref is a responsible human assignee, never a worker lease. responsible_queue_ref is non-null even while no human has claimed the item.

commands.work.list: Resolve current staff tenant/queue/resource grants, discover pending/uncertain/orphaned/source-action work without prior refs; opaque cursor is server-bound to scope and filters. Return only current authorized assignee choices.
commands.work.claim: CAS expected_revision; assign current authenticated staff principal to self after directory/group/resource checks. Never takes a caller actor proof.
commands.work.assign: CAS expected_revision; current assignment permission and directory resolution of assignee_ref are mandatory; changing owner does not grant source financial authority.
commands.work.handoff: CAS expected_revision; current assigned owner picks action_ref from source-qualified next_actions. Resolve original binding and required current human/source authority; atomically write handoff intent/outbox/event/work status, then source dispatch. Received receipt transitions awaiting_source, not resolved.
commands.work.reconcile: Current authorized staff query of original source handoff/action only; verify source completion and atomically update work/domain/outbox/inbox/receipt. No browser completion flag, source receipt body, retry instruction or amount accepted.

x-workflow.runner: Register concrete CommercialWorkRunner at the AMH composition factory/lifecycle with admitted service identity. run_once invokes tenant-scoped journal.pending pages for ready/dispatching/uncertain/reconciling/live and orphan scan, revalidates original authority, queries original source operation before any effect, then uses fenced JournalWorker/reconciliation and updates durable owner queue. No import-time thread or cloud deployment is authorized by this proposal.
x-workflow.query_before_effect: Known terminal result is acknowledged atomically; live/unknown result stays uncertain and responsible. Dispatch from ready only after authoritative not-started/no-live-effect evidence plus current effect authority and stable source dedupe guarantees. Absence/null/lease expiry alone never proves no effect. Uncertain paths never blindly resend.
x-workflow.manual_sources: Unsupported provider financial mutation remains source_action_required and enters durable responsible work. SourceWorkPort.discover_actions/submit_handoff/read_completion are called by concrete service/runner composition; action refs are qualified capabilities for original immutable provider/account/invoice/authorization. No guessed provider endpoint or generic success fallback.
x-workflow.callbacks: Existing mounted qualified PSP notification ingress feeds the same source query and atomic work acknowledgement. Manual/source handoff completes by concrete polling in work.reconcile and runner; no new external callback endpoint/schema is introduced. Any future source callback requires its own qualification and cannot bypass authenticated source readback.
x-workflow.closure: Resolved work requires matching qualified source completion receipt. Handoff received, staff assignment, elapsed lease or human checkbox cannot release charge guards or imply refund/dispute/cancel completion. Work completion and underlying financial facts remain distinct.
x-workflow.scope_index: Pending/work index and cursors must be tenant+responsible-queue scoped before returning refs; the existing global state-only GSI helper is not a staff authorization boundary. Recheck current record membership/revision on every claim/dispatch. Preserve original bindings and never claim foreign work.
x-workflow.durability: Owner queue creation/update, outbox state, domain revision and receipt/event write are transactionally coupled. Crashes at any boundary retain discoverable responsibility and stable original operation; no best-effort enqueue after commit.
x-workflow.recovery: operation.get for a work command revalidates current staff/tenant/queue/resource and assignee-directory disclosure scope before returning sanitized prior data; recovered next_actions or owner refs never confer permission. Missing current grants refuse rather than echo stale private work snapshots.

x-payment-observation.method: Existing method remains requested choice, immutable; it is never displayed or posted as an observed financial fact.
x-payment-observation.observed_method: Nullable pix|card|boleto, populated only from authenticated original-account/invoice/operation-bound actual capture evidence, with observed_method_receipt_ref; both null or both non-null. No provider-default, requested-method or configured-method inference.
x-payment-observation.unknown_paid: Provider-authenticated paid may remain true with observed_method null; preserve paid receipt and money guard, route accounting_pending owner work, and do not acknowledge/post to Tasy until actual method is qualified. Do not create another charge.
x-payment-observation.method_mismatch: For example, qualified InfinitePay capture_method credit_card maps to card even when requested method is pix; retain both. Never invent unsupported Pix-only checkout. Accounting receives qualified observed method only, with current source mapping/permission, never the requested choice.
x-payment-observation.ack_monotonicity: PSP polling cannot change acknowledged Tasy posting back to pending, erase its receipt, reclaim a terminal accounting intent or issue a new accounting effect because provider receipt_ref changed. Accounting business dedupe binds original attempt/invoice/posting identity independently from observation receipt churn; any correction requires separate current source authority and preserved history.
x-payment-observation.lookup_custody: After authenticated fully bound lookup, atomically persist provider_payment_ref and provider-specific transaction_nsu/invoice_slug or equivalent protected lookup refs with the observation and original binding revision. Later manual/worker reconciliation reloads them. Unsigned hints cannot persist authority or replace these refs; conflicting verified refs are quarantined/owned, not overwritten. No raw identifiers in keys/logs/browser results.
x-payment-observation.read_refresh: receivable.get composes TasyPort.read_current for original qualified binding and exact contract/payer/obligation/receivable, validates source revision/currentness, then atomically updates its projection. A local journal snapshot is not a successful current source refresh.
x-payment-observation.late_expiry: All fresh hosted-document/checkout URL, context and qualification deadline checks run as final pure checks after all authority IO and immediately before disclosure; preserve original durable effect evidence and return null-data uncertainty where appropriate.

x-catalog-associations.schema: CatalogRow.network_associations[]: establishment_ref, unit_ref nullable, service_ref, association_source_ref, source_revision. Parent row binds product_ref and network_ref/network_version.
x-catalog-associations.identity: The exact product/network/version/establishment/unit/service tuple identifies an association; reject duplicate/conflicting tuples. All refs are selectors into qualified source membership, not proof.
x-catalog-associations.cardinality: Maximum100 associations per row as technical envelope bound; minimum, required unit, allowed services, membership and relationship cardinality come from the current published source contract. Empty array/null unit never means universally allowed or no network; absent mandatory source semantics prevents publication.
x-catalog-associations.currentness: Source lookup validates all tuple refs, membership, source_revision and public field semantics before draft/import custody, and again at review/publication. Server uses source time, not caller claimed currentness.
x-catalog-associations.csv: Explicit csv_rows_v2 adds network_associations JSON-array column to existing exact columns; real form supports repeatable structured association rows. Reject whole batch on duplicate/unknown/wrong-parent/foreign/stale tuple. No free-text encoding in attributes.
x-catalog-associations.history: Include tuples and source revisions in immutable catalog digest/version/CAS. No retrofit into an already approved digest. Old rows lacking associations are not silently backfilled; create a new qualified reviewed version.
x-catalog-associations.public: Source v2 maps qualified approved display fields to source-owned public association refs; presentation v3 strips establishment/unit/service/private association refs and retains approved names or explicit unknown plus verifiedAt. Customer details display multiple establishments/units/services; membership does not establish coverage.

x-customer-journey.identity: Resolve current authenticated account/represented-party/prospect linkage independently before discovery, source reads, body intake or browser rehydration. Account is not beneficiary; pre-enrollment saved intent may have account/payer/party refs absent where source legitimately has no later-stage link.
x-customer-journey.save: journey.save requires exact current source-qualified quote/source_revision/terms_digest and existing authorized prospect/profile relation. Atomically persist intent plus tenant/owner/source-linkage journey index and event; result proves saving application state only, not source acceptance/issuance/enrollment or marketing opt-in. The application journey_ref is not an AMH subject/beneficiary identity.
x-customer-journey.storage_composition: prospect.save and explicit journey.save register the source-bound owner journey index; subsequent quote/acceptance/issuance/receipt/uncertain/work/support changes atomically retain exact journey context. Never rely on only React state or a manual reference supplied after reload.
x-customer-journey.discovery: journey.get with journey_ref null calls current source account/represented-party/application lookup, merges only current-authorized local saved-intent and pending-command index entries, and returns a bounded source-current projection. A provided journey_ref is separately owner/resource/currentness checked; cursor is server-bound to current scope. Missing source mapping does not become an empty successful account. Pending-operation projection excludes private operator/catalog-administration/work-queue commands and rechecks the current customer command/resource audience, not merely a matching principal string.
x-customer-journey.composition: Sales admitted customer DAL → existing private typed transport → Maezo journey facade → AMH concrete JourneyService → source discovery/current-read adapters and durable index. Mount actual handlers and invoke them on /acompanhamento and admitted CommercialWorkspace initialization/reload; public /ajuda remains explanatory until admission, then uses the same current support context.
x-customer-journey.tracking: Reuse CustomerAcceptanceRead/CustomerEnrollmentRead/CustomerCoverageRead nominal shapes. Contract-issued, enrollment and coverage have separate source evidence; paid/settled/accepted never derives coverage. Source absence stays refused/unknown in the affected field, with actual observation time rather than a hardcoded historical timestamp.
x-customer-journey.documents: Documents/requiredness/pending/next-owner/action are current source-qualified administrative projections only. Required fields/doc protocols and case enums are not invented. Hosted document delivery is fresh under independent issuer document-origin policy; clinical content is not copied/collected in portal.
x-customer-journey.support: support.handoff accepts only current journey_ref and immutable source-published topic_ref. Resolve original application/context and current OP07 commercial audience/topic/vocabulary, then atomic responsible work/outbox/receipt and competent source handoff. Generic contact.request is separate. Unknown source topic/protocol remains unavailable; no free clinical text or invented native-case endpoint.
x-customer-journey.support_vocabulary: CustomerSupportRead is an explicit sales-support-case.proposed.v2 successor to the old empty-vocabulary projection. Strings in JSON Schema require exact current source-published caseKind/caseStatus membership, vocabularyRef/revision and matching approved labels server-side; never mutate or infer the historical empty enums.
x-customer-journey.support_readback: journey.get refreshes source support/case context after handoff; requested/pending/received are not resolved. A source case resolution may be displayed only under its current published semantics and receipt; support is never acceptance, issuance, enrollment or coverage.
x-customer-journey.external_clinical: A source-advertised external clinical topic may return a qualified external_handoff URL under separately approved channel-origin and current authority. Portal collects no clinical body and does not infer clinical resolution.
x-customer-journey.recovery: Revalidate current owner/resource/source before every replay. Strip documents[].hosted_document and support external_handoff to null before storage/outbox/recovery; use RecoveredJourneySnapshotResultData/RecoveredSupportHandoffResultData inside operation.get. Direct write replay of support.handoff returns sanitized data with no old URL. New journey.get performs current reads and may produce fresh qualified URLs; old recovered snapshot alone never enables actions. Direct replay of completed journey.get returns unavailable/journey_unavailable, never a stale snapshot presented as fresh; request a new command_ref for a current read. Direct support.handoff replay may return its sanitized receipt only and never repeats handoff. Explicit journey.save business dedupe binds current tenant/owner and exact quote/revision/digest.
x-customer-journey.privacy: No browser storage authority, automatic old-state restoration, clinical free-form intake or marketing permission inferred by save. Fetch current admitted source state on re-entry and recover pending commands with original operation.get/query, never redispatch writes.

x-public-price.provenance: Every known amount and its kind/unit/period/applicability/currentness is a genuinely current publicly qualified Tasy/source fact for that catalog/product revision. Source receipts and internal price-table IDs stay server-only; priceRef and contextRef are approved public references, not authority.
x-public-price.unknown: Exactly {dataState:unknown}; no amount/currency/zero/default. An operator need not publish a numeric value. Missing public permission or complete source semantics never becomes known availability or guessed value.
x-public-price.representation: amountMinor is exact nonnegative BRL minor units. Zero is allowed only as an actual published zero. Source decimal-to-minor conversion is exact representation, never rounding, repricing, discount, multiplication or eligibility calculation.
x-public-price.semantics: amountKind reference/estimate/exact_unit/exact_total is source-published. unit per_life/per_contract/published_composition and source period/applicability identify exactly what the value describes. No inferred from-price, minimum, aggregate total or personal eligibility.
x-public-price.comparison: Numerical cost comparison/sort requires source-qualified identical comparisonBasisRef, currency, unit, period and applicable context/version. Null/different basis or unknown/incompatible values remain explicitly incomparable; never normalize periods, sum per-life values, convert currency or rank as equivalent from labels.
x-public-price.currentness: Validate exact source revision, current publication/withdrawal and each verifiedAt/validUntil after source IO. Null validity requires current source qualification, not indefinite validity; no invented TTL. Late expiry revokes numeric disclosure.
x-public-price.composition: Source publisher obtains and validates full known/unknown branch before atomic projection+active pointer commit. All three GETs, translator, DAL and public results/detail/comparison/S06 preserve it. Availability-only translation is insufficient.
x-public-price.privacy: Read-only published facts need no account; independent guest/subject admission before any REAL preferences/client state or personalized source estimate remains mandatory. Formal proposal follows deliberate proceed/S07 identity; public amount is not a personal quote or grant.

x-payment-capabilities.qualification: Fresh exact intersection of implemented officially documented wire profile, operator own-account/source binding, current provider+method+operation capability, current contractual use, actor/resource/tenant/purpose/lifecycle and source revision. x-payment-capabilities.scope_use: Connection/operator sets are administrative readiness only. Actual checkout uses the current receivable-scoped set; mandate creation uses current contract-scoped set; existing payment/mandate actions use their original resource-scoped set and immutable binding, independently from new operator configuration.
x-payment-capabilities.selection: payment.create and mandate.create require choice_ref. It is a selector resolved at the current source, never proof. Recheck membership, immutable choice tuple/version, scope/ref, current revision/expiry, requested provider/method/operation/use and actual contractual eligibility before preparation/effects. Rotate choice ref when meaning/binding/use changes; stale refs refuse.
x-payment-capabilities.create_semantics: payment.create with mandate_ref null selects payment.create/one_time; nonnull selects payment.create/invoice_with_mandate for Stripe card plus current active opt-in and new Tasy invoice. mandate.create selects mandate.create/mandate_authorization for Stripe card under exact contract. x-payment-capabilities.defaults: default_card_choice_ref may reference only a current Stripe card/payment.create/one_time choice. If absent/unqualified it is null; no automatic replacement. x-payment-capabilities.implemented_potential: Stripe:card one-time/qualified optional mandate and invoice-with-mandate. InfinitePay:one-time pix/card and reconcile only. Asaas:source-eligible hosted boleto/pix/card and reconcile only. Static matrix describes possible profiles, never current publication/merchant approval.
x-payment-capabilities.ui: Render exact current scope-qualified choices only; hide/disable unsupported/stale/unavailable operations before interaction. No hardcoded provider dropdown or InfinitePay mandate. Refresh via existing operator/contract/receivable/mandate reads and original payment reconciliation; source recheck also occurs on submit.
x-payment-capabilities.expiry: valid_until is source-published or explicitly null with fresh source qualification. Unknown expiry is not unlimited permission. Current sets are read-session presentation, not durable grants; elapsed/revoked state hides choices.
x-payment-capabilities.replay: Before journal/outbox/recovery replace each payment_capabilities object with PaymentCapabilitiesUnavailable scoped to the same resource, reason refresh_required, empty choices/default null. OriginalOperationalResult enforces unavailable at nested views/connections/journeys. Direct replay does not advertise cached choices; fetch a new current read before interaction. C6 URL redaction remains unchanged.
x-payment-capabilities.configuration: Keep existing stripe_card/infinitepay_pix_card/asaas_boleto connection slots for identity compatibility; the Asaas slot identifies its own account, not a prohibition on its source-qualified Pix/card alternatives. No new merchant or platform custody account is invented.
x-payment-capabilities.negative: No qualified set/source proof means no transactional choice. A paid/issued fact remains a fact even when capabilities become unavailable; unavailable capability data does not erase receipts or permit a new charge.

x-asaas-eligible-profile.pix_proof: Authenticated original payment.pixTransaction → GET /v3/pix/transactions/{id} under same account; bind transaction id/payment/value/type CREDIT/status DONE and source evidence. QR availability/billingInfo/redirect are not payment proof.
x-asaas-eligible-profile.card_proof: Current authenticated paid payment with documented used-card evidence and explicitly qualified CREDIT_CARD or DEBIT_CARD mapping. x-asaas-eligible-profile.accounting: Preserve C6 requested/observed separation and receipts. If accounting requires card subtype and it is unknown/unqualified, defer accounting under owner work; never relabel debit as credit. No second charge for method uncertainty.
x-asaas-eligible-profile.url_expiry: invoiceUrl absolute expiry unknown in inspected contract; do not derive from dueDate or pixQrCode.expirationDate. Null hosted_action expiry still requires fresh qualified delivery.

x-asaas-eligible-profile.notifications: Retain current customer notificationDisabled proof and postalService=false. Do not add fictional payment notificationDisabled field or infer marketing consent.
x-asaas-eligible-profile.financial_actions: Research also lists refund/chargeback routes, but this delta does not implement/authorize them. Existing qualified source/owner handoff and completion gates remain unchanged. InfinitePay app recurrence is not publication of an external mandate API.
